statement: For the exact periodized BF field at L=24, under the typed six-pin maximum-saddle pair-Palm law, there exists a finite C_ext^max such that the expected number of local maxima in T_24^2 minus B3 with values in (b-r^3/6,b) is at most C_ext^max r^3 uniformly for 0<r<=0.025.

proof_objects.scaled_pair_weight: The six-pin pair constraints give H_xx(M),H_xx(S)=O(r), H_xy(M),H_xy(S)=O(r), and H_yy(M),H_yy(S)=O(1); hence W_MS=r^2 W_hat_r in the corrected divided-difference frame.
proof_objects.denominator: Z_r=E[W_MS|J6]=r^2 z_r with z_r->z_0>0; the archived exact limit is z_0=3.230979-class.
proof_objects.exterior_gaussian_extension: For x outside B3, the exact analytic six-pin Schur law of (f(x),grad f(x),H_M,H_S,H_x), expressed in the corrected divided-difference frame, extends continuously to r=0.
proof_objects.density_floor: The conditional covariance of (f(x),grad f(x)) is uniformly positive definite on the compact exterior parameter set.
proof_objects.weighted_moment: After conditioning on f(x)=u and grad f(x)=0, r^-2 E[W_MS W_x^max] is bounded by continuity plus uniform Gaussian polynomial moments. Index-boundary sets have Gaussian measure zero, so the typed moment is continuous.
proof_objects.compact_interval: u belongs to [b-r^3/6,b], which lies in a fixed compact height interval and converges uniformly to b.

formal_bound.intensity_bound: sup_{0<r<=0.025,x in exterior,u in [b-ell,b]} lambda_max^Palm(x,u;r) <= M_ext < infinity
formal_bound.count_bound: E N_max(W_r;exterior) <= |exterior| M_ext ell = (|exterior| M_ext/6) r^3

continuity_argument: For sufficiently small r, use the corrected divided-difference frame and the positive limit z_0.
For r in a closed interval [r_1,0.025], ordinary covariance nondegeneracy and compactness give a finite maximum.
Take the larger of the two finite bounds.

diagnostic_support.interpretation: The station atlas is not used to prove compactness, but it falsification-checks the predicted approach to the stationary maximum-height intensity.

dependencies: six-pin conditional covariance factorization and differentiated form
KR-V nondegeneracy away from the pins
not_claimed: No explicit numerical C_ext^max is certified here.
The near region and collar coefficients are not closed by this theorem.
